entries.title: Genesis 11:1
segments: ¶And all the earth had one language and one tongue.

entries.title: Genesis 11:2
segments: And it came about that in their wandering from the east, they came to a stretch of flat country in the land of Shinar, and there they made their living-place.

entries.title: Genesis 11:3
segments: And they said one to another, Come, let us make bricks, burning them well. And they had bricks for stone, putting them together with sticky earth.

entries.title: Genesis 11:4
segments: And they said, Come, let us make a town, and a tower whose top will go up as high as heaven; and let us make a great name for ourselves, so that we may not be wanderers over the face of the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 11:5
segments: ¶And the Lord came down to see the town and the tower which the children of men were building.

entries.title: Genesis 11:6
segments: And the Lord said, See, they are all one people and have all one language; and this is only the start of what they may do: and now it will not be possible to keep them from any purpose of theirs.

entries.title: Genesis 11:7
segments: Come, let us go down and take away the sense of their language, so that they will not be able to make themselves clear to one another.

entries.title: Genesis 11:8
segments: So the Lord God sent them away into every part of the earth: and they gave up building their town.

entries.title: Genesis 11:9
segments: So it was named Babel, because there the Lord took away the sense of all languages and from there the Lord sent them away over all the face of the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 11:10
segments: ¶These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad, two years after the great flow of waters;

entries.title: Genesis 11:11
segments: And after the birth of Arpachshad, Shem went on living for five hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:12
segments: And Arpachshad was thirty-five years old when he became the father of Shelah:

entries.title: Genesis 11:13
segments: And after the birth of Shelah, Arpachshad went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:14
segments: And Shelah was thirty years old when he became the father of Eber:

entries.title: Genesis 11:15
segments: And after the birth of Eber, Shelah went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:16
segments: And Eber was thirty-four years old when he became the father of Peleg:

entries.title: Genesis 11:17
segments: And after the birth of Peleg, Eber went on living for four hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:18
segments: And Peleg was thirty years old when he became the father of Reu:

entries.title: Genesis 11:19
segments: And after the birth of Reu, Peleg went on living for two hundred and nine years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:20
segments: And Reu was thirty-two years old when he became the father of Serug:

entries.title: Genesis 11:21
segments: And after the birth of Serug, Reu went on living for two hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:22
segments: And Serug was thirty years old when he became the father of Nahor:

entries.title: Genesis 11:23
segments: And after the birth of Nahor, Serug went on living for two hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:24
segments: And Nahor was twenty-nine years old when he became the father of Terah:

entries.title: Genesis 11:25
segments: And after the birth of Terah, Nahor went on living for a hundred and nineteen years, and had sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 11:26
segments: And Terah was seventy years old when he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 11:27
segments: ¶These are the generations of Terah: Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.

entries.title: Genesis 11:28
segments: And death came to Haran when he was with his father Terah in the land of his birth, Ur of the Chaldees.

entries.title: Genesis 11:29
segments: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and Iscah.

entries.title: Genesis 11:30
segments: And Sarai had no child.

entries.title: Genesis 11:31
segments: And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, the son of Haran, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son Abram and they went out from Ur of the Chaldees, to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran, and were there for some time.

entries.title: Genesis 11:32
segments: And all the years of Terah's life were two hundred and five: and Terah came to his end in Haran.
